correctness.rationale: An induction on support clauses shows that uniform ∀¹/∃¹ never introduces a second varying coordinate, while implication merely restricts to subsets S⊆D; every reachable team is encoded by one monadic S and globally fixed individual constants. Recursively translate atomic equality, bot, inquisitive whole-team disjunction, subteam implication (∀U⊆S), and uniform quantifiers into monadic second-order logic with only unary set variables. In pure equality with unary predicate R, a q-round MSO game with 2^q color-class cutoff covers finite and infinite D; every q-type is FO-definable by bounded-count equality formulas. Separate first-order unary color-type truncation plus downward closure yields either bounded |R| or minimum complement size on all sufficiently large nonempty teams, while each small finite D has an initial segment. Uniform witness formulas B_k and E_d realize every alternative; empty teams are accepted throughout. Rechecked 1,386 independently implemented finite cases for B_k/E_d and whole-team inquisitive disjunction plus representative implication semantics, but the all-domain theorem rests on the semantic induction and rank games, not enumerations.
residual_risks: The proof presupposes pure equality, uniform-value quantifiers, nonempty universes and ≤1 initially varying coordinate.
MSO game 2^q cutoff is sufficient, not claimed sharp; finite experiments do not certify infinite-model collapse.

value.rationale: This gives a sharp natural expressiveness boundary directly prompted by the published non-first-order binary example: one varying coordinate admits a complete FO classification and an explicit eventual cardinality dichotomy, while two coordinates do not. The result is a structural distinction between unary/team-set and genuinely relational teams, useful in finite model theory and logic semantics beyond textbook MSO collapse alone.
residual_risks: Expressiveness boundary is only pure-equality uniform InqBT; stronger range quantifier and richer vocabularies excluded.

limitations: No claim for arity≥2, non-equality signatures, or range-generating quantifier.
Converse direction and monadic MSO finite-rank collapse are prior work.
